# weir list

<!-- Generated by `weir reference`. Do not edit: change the help text in src/main.rs and regenerate. -->

List mirrored repositories, one per line.

```text
List mirrored repositories, one per line

Usage: weir list [OPTIONS] [TARGET]

Arguments:
  [TARGET]


Options:
      --archived
          Include mirrors of repositories that were archived upstream

      --json
          Machine-readable output

      --all
          Include every repository weir knows, whatever its state

  -q, --quiet
          Print errors only

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
